title: fusionAIze Provider Catalog v1.4
description: Provider catalog with pricing, capabilities, and freshness metadata. v1.1 (additive): adds tier_status and expires_at per-provider fields. v1.2 (additive): adds modalities, image token pricing, free_tier, and evidence metadata. v1.3 (additive): splits the single fused recommended_model string into separate vendor/model/variant/hop fields (the canonical ID path is generated from these, never parsed from a string), splits modalities into input_modalities/output_modalities, adds capacity fields with mandatory evidence, and reserves the auto/ intent namespace. v1.4 (additive): adds entry_type (model/vendor/plan), context_window, limits, and context_evidence so every entry can declare a context window — measured (confirmed) for model entries, derived (plausible) for manufacturer and plan rollups. Also adds context_window_min_measured + context_measurement to record a directly observed lower bound separately from any third-party claim. Older consumers ignore unknown fields.

schema_version.description: fusionaize-provider-catalog version string, e.g. 'fusionaize-provider-catalog/v1.2'. v1, v1.1, and v1.2 are all valid; older consumers ignore unknown fields.

routing_modes.$comment: v1.3: the reserved auto/ intent namespace. These are the absichtsbasiert (intent-based) routing modes, each in canonical auto/<name> form. 'auto' is itself the default intent, hence auto/auto. A physical provider entry must never occupy this prefix.

model_caps.$comment: v1.3: model-keyed input-token ceilings migrated from faigate's hand-written _MODEL_INPUT_CAPS. Keyed by concrete model ID (not provider), because the input ceiling is a property of the model, not of any single provider. Every value carries an evidence block; facts migrated from a source with no provenance are unconfirmed.

model_versions.$comment: v1.3: canonical-lane -> concrete model + human label, migrated from faigate's _ACTIVE_MODEL_VERSIONS and _MODEL_VERSION_LABELS. Keyed by canonical lane ID. The two tables are merged here into one record per lane because they always share a key. Migrated values carry no per-entry source, so their evidence is unconfirmed.

recommended_model.$comment: v1.3 (MUSS-2, option a): recommended_model is DERIVED, never stored. In pre-v1.3 catalogs it was a stored value carrying the full upstream identity; v1.3 splits that identity into vendor/model/variant/hop, so the stored field is gone. Loaders reconstruct it as `model` for an auto-selectable provider (tier_status absent, 'active', or 'preview') and `null` for a non-auto-selectable one ('expired' or 'deprecated'). A stored recommended_model must NOT appear in the data file; the schema keeps this property only so that a legacy document carrying the field is still accepted (additionalProperties tolerates it) without the field being read as a second, driftable truth.

tier_status.description: v1.1: lifecycle state of this provider tier. Defaults to 'active' when absent.

expires_at.description: v1.1: ISO date after which this provider entry should be treated as expired (free tier ends, deprecated, etc.)

items.$comment: Divergence: provider-catalog.v1.schema.json accepts 'image_generation' in its modalities enum while model-catalog.v1.schema.json does not. Reconciling the two vocabularies is an open decision, not resolved here.

input_modalities.$comment: v1.3: what the model RECEIVES. Split from the flat 'modalities' list so a model can take image input and produce text output (e.g. the vision model). 'vision' migrated to input 'image'; 'image_generation' migrated to output 'image'.

output_modalities.$comment: v1.3: what the model PRODUCES. Split from the flat 'modalities' list. 'text' stays text on both sides; 'image_generation' becomes output 'image'.

entry_type.description: v1.4: the kind of entry. 'model' is a concrete model with a real context window; 'vendor' is a manufacturer rollup spanning several models with different windows; 'plan' is a subscription/bundle rollup over several coding models. A vendor/plan entry carries a DERIVED context_window (plausible, from its primary model), not a measured one; a model entry may carry a confirmed value.

context_window.description: v1.4: the context window size in tokens. For a model entry this is the model's real window (confirmed when sourced); for a vendor/plan entry it is DERIVED from the entry's primary model and must be plausible, with provenance in context_evidence.derived_from.

max_input_tokens.description: v1.4: the in-band input-token ceiling for this entry. Kept equal to context_window for single-model and derived rollup entries; a downstream router may further band-limit independently.

context_evidence.description: v1.4: provenance for context_window/limits. A confirmed value cites source + source_url + as_of; a derived value carries level plausible and derived_from naming the source model/cap.

context_window_min_measured.description: v1.4: a directly measured lower bound for the context window, in tokens. This is NOT a context_window replacement — it is a separate, independently sourced observation. Must be <= context_window when both are present. Provenance lives in context_measurement.

tool.description: The tool or component that performed the measurement, e.g. 'faigate 2.7.0'.

probed_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the probe was conducted.

tokens_accepted.description: The highest prompt_token count accepted by the model in the probe.

served_by_verified.description: Whether the served_by field was verified on every probe to confirm model identity.

lower_bound_reason.description: Why this is a lower bound and not the true context window. E.g. a gateway payload guard capped the probe before the model limit was reached.

context_measurement.description: v1.4: provenance for context_window_min_measured. Records the measurement tool, date, and the reason the observed value is a lower bound rather than the true window.

vendor.description: v1.3: the model manufacturer. Part of the canonical ID path [hop/]vendor/model[:variant], generated from separate fields, never parsed from a string.

model.description: v1.3: the model identifier. Part of the canonical ID path. Must not repeat a segment already present via vendor or hop, and must not claim the reserved auto/ intent namespace.

variant.description: v1.3: optional variant suffix (:variant), e.g. reasoning-effort tiers or 'free'. Omitted when absent. Must not claim the reserved auto/ intent namespace.

hop.description: v1.3: ordered list of intermediaries (resellers/gateways/hosts) prefixed before vendor/model in the canonical ID path. Empty for direct providers; e.g. blackboxai/... -> hop: [blackboxai]. No intermediary may repeat (a loop is exactly what the trail exists to make visible), and no segment may claim the reserved auto/ prefix.

evidence.description: v1.3: mandatory whenever a token capacity value is present. A capacity value without evidence is rejected.

image_tokens_max.description: v1.2: maximum number of tokens one image is billed as (e.g. DeepSeek V4-Flash-Vision tokenizes an image up to 384 tokens, charged at the model's normal token price).

allOf.$comment: v1.3: vendor and model are a coupled pair. Either both are present (physical ID path) or neither (legacy/other entry). A model without a vendor would re-fuse identity into a single string.
